liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (3 reviews): Donna's first caterwaul appears around 12:14 in this song, and it is also preserved on Dick's Picks 30; Donna first added her wail at the end of the jam here; it became a regular feature afterward [8][11][15]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): The reviewer finds this performance especially sweet [10]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): The crowd is audibly into the show, with enthusiastic clapping along to the band during this song [7]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Jerry's pedal steel playing on this song comes through well on the recording [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-28.132729.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 219 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: This soundboard is a clear sound upgrade over earlier circulating versions of the show [10]
- **gd72-03-28.aud.hanno.15414.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 219 min; rated 1.8/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Bass is overdriven and distorted and sits high in the mix, while the other instruments are faint and hard to hear [4]
- **gd1972-03-28.aud.teute-bunjes.sirmick.24536.shnf**: audience recording; 26 songs; 219 min; rated 1.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: This audience tape is better than the other circulating audience source, though still rough; The audience recording's sound is extremely poor; the reviewer recommends the official Dick's Picks 30 instead; Original recording had serious deficiencies; the remaster is listenable for most of the show, but problems remain [3][7][8]

## Around the show

- The band played these shows partly to help fund the Europe '72 tour [6]
- The encore began with Sidewalks Of New York, followed by One More Saturday Night [1]
- The official Dick's Picks 30 release sounds far better than this audience tape, which is the weaker source [6]
- Reviewer calls it the best show of this run and among the better shows of 1972 [12]
- Among traders, this show and 9/27/72 were the year's great missing soundboards [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-28.132729.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Soundboard transfer with seamless disc changes; the first few seconds of El Paso are missing because of a reel flip [1]
- **gd72-03-28.aud.hanno.15414.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [2]
- **gd1972-03-28.aud.teute-bunjes.sirmick.24536.shnf**: transferred by SIRMick; source: AUD C/5 > SoundForge > CDR [3]. Also: Uploader remastered the audience recording himself, in a way purists may dislike [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [17]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [18]
